description: This file defines an enumeration 'ConfigRestoredAction' used for IPC messaging in a service, representing different actions related to configuration restoration events. It includes constants, a constructor, and utility methods for value translation.

classes.name: ConfigRestoredAction
classes.description: Enumeration representing various configuration restoration actions with associated numeric codes, supporting translation from integer codes to enum instances.

methods.name: getNumValue
methods.description: Returns the numeric value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: enumForInt
methods.description: Returns the enum constant corresponding to a given integer code, or null if unrecognized.
